verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents a first-party Exporting Data feature: docs files or a PDF can be exported from the Branch menu, and via tooling and the API. Bi-directional Git sync keeps docs as Markdown and OpenAPI in your own repository, which supports leaving in open formats. Export of anything beyond doc content is not shown. Missing for 10: evidence that ALL data (metrics, API logs, developer data, settings) can be exported, explicit detail on export file formats, and independent hands-on confirmation of a full migration off ReadMe.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: You can export the files in your docs or as a PDF from the Branch menu.
Export your docs using our built-in features, tooling, and our API.
Run documentation entirely through Git, with Markdown and OpenAPI in your repository and pull requests as the review step.
Bi-directional sync creates a two-way connection between your ReadMe project and a GitHub or GitLab repository.
